title: baboon-acoustics: formant, F0, glottal-source and vocal-tract-length analysis tools
description:
Python tools for the acoustic analysis of baboon vocalizations, supplementary to the article “Re-analysis of formant trajectories in a chacma baboon wahoo vocalization” (anonymized for review; a comment on Boë et al. 2026, International Journal of Primatology).

The package provides: formant tracking with Praat’s Burg LPC method (via Parselmouth, configurable number of poles); sliding iterative adaptive inverse filtering (IAIF, Alku 1991) yielding the glottal source, the vocal-tract envelope and formant tracks; fundamental-frequency estimation by autocorrelation, including a Gaussian pre-filter that emulates Praat’s filtered autocorrelation and resists subharmonic errors; vocal-tract-length estimation after Reby & McComb (2003); and glottal-source analysis (single-pulse extraction and full pulse-train reconstruction with phase-portrait and spectral views). Four scripts reproduce all figures of the article exactly from the provided audio files.
